prompt: Make a histogram of the temp_c values.

before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided weather data
weather = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Plot a histogram of all temperature values
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.hist(weather['temp_c'].dropna(), bins=6, edgecolor='black')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Histogram of Temperature Values')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
